_note: M9 fixture: AMEK EQ 200. Carries the ROLE and ENABLE LINK (session 1), and the LADDER POINTS and ARM A INJECTION (session 3). The chooser runs only when nothing pins the points: measured on this suite, a centred 2-octave pair lands at 54.1/216.3 Hz against these pinned 100/400, so a chooser-driven run cannot reproduce a pinned run's numbers and is not a regression test. The real AMEK map carries neither role nor enabled_by: option (i) was signed -- the corpus gets them when AMEK is re-mapped under schema 2.3, rather than tooling writing them into a human-verified artefact.

enabled_by.name: Mono Maker In
enabled_by.why: Mono Maker is inert until its In switch is engaged

arm_a_injection.why: A deliberate mis-map needs a nominated wrong-index control of a specific character: not a filter, and measurably live in a band the falsifier can read. No general map declares such a thing, which is why arm A is FIXTURE-ONLY and refuses to run without this declaration.
